column1: # TeX Live manuals (ci/manuals.json) whose PDF differs from the oracle's only where pdfTeX has a bug PhiTeX does not copy (docs/differences.md). Each id, a tab, the entry in docs/differences.md, a tab, the mask (scripts/ci/pdfdiff.py MASKS) of what may differ, a tab, the oracle's object numbers it may differ in (space-separated; python3 scripts/ci/pdfdiff.py ORACLE PHITEX MASK lists them). sweep.py --documented compares such a manual with the oracle built in the job: the objects' places, every other object, and the listed objects once masked must be identical (status documented); anything else is red.
